reason: I have never paid for a creator tool and YouTube Studio plus free vidIQ and ChatGPT already get me my weekly ideas. A tool that also pushes affiliate products and local deals at my audience feels like it would cost me trust before it gives me any views.
objection: If Mitra starts putting shop and affiliate offers into my videos, my subscribers will feel I am selling to them, and that is the one thing I cannot get back.
would_change_my_mind: A free month where Mitra's title or hook beat my usual views on a real video, and I could see that in my own numbers, with no sponsored or affiliate content forced into my uploads.
